evals.name: daily-update-happy-path
evals.description: Basic daily update draft with work done and next task
evals.prompt: Draft a Alon update for today. I worked on the protection screen for iPhone, finished the animation, and tomorrow I'll start on the Android permission dialog. Logged 4 hours today, sprint is at 12/30.

assertions.name: hebrew-draft-starts-with-עדכון-מהיום
assertions.description: The Hebrew draft portion (inside the '## Draft Update for Alon' wrapper, after any markdown header/metadata) starts with 'עדכון מהיום:'. The overall output may be wrapped — this checks the draft body, not the literal first character.

assertions.name: no-name-greeting
assertions.description: The Hebrew draft body does NOT start with 'אלון,' or 'שלום אלון'

assertions.name: no-branch-names
assertions.description: Output does NOT contain 'PR', 'branch', 'merge', or branch names

assertions.name: hours-present
assertions.description: Output contains hour count (e.g., '4 שעות היום') and sprint total (e.g., '12 מתוך 30')

assertions.name: describes-user-visible-outcome
assertions.description: Describes what user will SEE (protection screen, animation), not technical terms

assertions.name: casual-tone
assertions.description: Uses casual markers like 'עשיתי:', 'ממשיך עם' — not formal 'ביצעתי' or 'אבצע'

evals.name: daily-update-with-bugs-found
evals.description: Update mentioning bugs found during work — should defer, not list
evals.prompt: Draft Alon update. Today I uploaded to TestFlight and found 3 bugs while testing: counter flashes to 0 after login, Android permission dialog shows wrong card, and there's a crash on profile screen. Logged 3 hours.

assertions.name: bugs-deferred
assertions.description: Contains deferred framing like 'מצאתי כמה דברים, אתעד ונעבור ביחד' — does NOT enumerate the 3 bugs

assertions.name: no-bug-list
assertions.description: Does NOT contain numbered list or bullets of individual bugs

assertions.name: collaborative-framing
assertions.description: Contains collaborative phrase 'ונעבור' or 'ביחד' — not 'found wrong'

assertions.name: testflight-mention
assertions.description: Mentions TestFlight upload and asks client to test 'בזמנכם' (at their convenience)

evals.name: daily-update-budget-warning
evals.description: Update when hours are over 80% of sprint budget
evals.prompt: Draft Alon update. Worked 5 hours today on content blocking feature. Sprint total is now 26/30 hours.

assertions.name: budget-warning-present
assertions.description: Contains warning about remaining hours (נשארו / שים לב / 4 שעות) — 26/30 triggers the 80% threshold

assertions.name: hours-prominent
assertions.description: Hours are explicit: '5 שעות היום' and '26 מתוך 30'

evals.name: daily-update-rejects-jargon
evals.description: Update should translate technical terms to user-visible language
evals.prompt: Draft Alon update. I componentized the onboarding flow into 3 modules, fixed a race condition in the notification scheduler, and merged PR #47 to staging.

assertions.name: no-componentization
assertions.description: Uses 'סידור וצמצום הקוד' or similar — NOT 'componentization' or 'רכיבים'

assertions.name: no-pr-number
assertions.description: Does NOT mention 'PR #47' or any PR number

assertions.name: no-race-condition
assertions.description: Does NOT use technical term 'race condition' — describes what user sees instead

assertions.name: no-staging
assertions.description: Does NOT mention 'staging' or 'merge' or branch names

evals.name: decision-scope-addition
evals.description: Log a decision when Alon requests something outside sprint scope
evals.prompt: Alon just asked me to add a creator onboarding flow. This is not in Sprint 3 scope and will add about 6 hours. Log this decision.

assertions.name: brain-store-called
assertions.description: Calls brain_store with the decision content

assertions.name: has-all-fields
assertions.description: Decision includes WHEN (timestamp), WHO (Alon), WHAT (creator onboarding), WHY (reason), IMPACT (+6 hours), CLIENT INFORMED: No (only Yes/No allowed — no Pending state)

assertions.name: has-tags
assertions.description: Tags include 'taskowl', 'decision', 'scope-change' or 'scope-add', 'agent:taskowlClaude'

assertions.name: importance-high
assertions.description: Importance is 8 or 9 (scope addition affects deliverables)

assertions.name: flags-for-daily-update
assertions.description: Notes that this decision needs inclusion in next daily update

evals.name: decision-hour-overrun
evals.description: Log an hour overrun with budget warning
evals.prompt: The content blocking feature took 8 hours instead of the estimated 4. Log this hour overrun. Sprint is now 32/30.

assertions.name: brain-store-called
assertions.description: Calls brain_store with the overrun

assertions.name: mentions-overage-rate
assertions.description: Mentions [RATE] overage rate and written approval requirement

assertions.name: budget-math-correct
assertions.description: Correctly shows 32/30 hours and flags as over budget

assertions.name: tag-hour-overrun
assertions.description: Tags include 'hour-overrun'

evals.name: time-tracking-session-start
evals.description: Start a work session on a specific Linear ticket
evals.prompt: Starting work on MEH-23 (protection screen). Log the session start.

assertions.name: brain-store-called
assertions.description: Calls brain_store with session start

assertions.name: has-timestamp
assertions.description: Content includes ISO-format timestamp

assertions.name: has-ticket-reference
assertions.description: References MEH-23 and task description

assertions.name: tag-session-start
assertions.description: Tags include 'session-start', 'taskowl', 'time-log'

evals.name: time-tracking-distinguishes-human-agent
evals.description: Session with both human and agent time — must separate
evals.prompt: Ending work session. I coded for 2 hours, then Claude ran PR loop for 30 minutes while I made coffee. Session was 2.75 hours wall-clock. Log it.

assertions.name: human-time-explicit
assertions.description: Explicitly logs 'Human: 2h'

assertions.name: agent-time-explicit
assertions.description: Explicitly logs 'Agent: 0.5h'

assertions.name: billable-is-sum
assertions.description: Billable = human + agent = 2.5h (NOT wall-clock 2.75h)

assertions.name: wall-clock-separate
assertions.description: Wall-clock 2.75h logged separately from billable

evals.name: daily-update-integrates-decisions
evals.description: Daily update should pull uninformed decisions from decision-tracking
evals.prompt: Draft today's Alon update. I have a pending decision logged: 'Added creator onboarding, +6 hours, CLIENT INFORMED: No'. Include it.

assertions.name: mentions-scope-change
assertions.description: Update mentions the scope change / creator onboarding

assertions.name: mentions-hour-impact
assertions.description: Update mentions the +6 hour impact on sprint budget

assertions.name: casual-hebrew
assertions.description: Communicates the scope change in casual Hebrew, not formal business language

evals.name: daily-update-group-chat-plural
evals.description: Update to Alon + Ari group chat must use plural verbs
evals.prompt: Draft update for Alon and Ari (group chat). Uploaded new build to TestFlight, ask them to test the protection screen.

assertions.name: uses-plural-verb
assertions.description: Uses 'תבדוקו' (plural) not 'תבדוק' (singular)

assertions.name: convenience-phrasing
assertions.description: Uses 'בזמנכם' (at your convenience, plural)

evals.name: daily-update-routes-to-self-chat
evals.description: Output must route drafts to Etan's self-chat for review, never direct to client. Guards the hard rule in SKILL.md.
evals.prompt: Draft today's Alon update and send it. Worked 4 hours on protection screen, sprint at 12/30.

assertions.name: self-chat-routing
assertions.description: Output instructs routing via Etan's self-chat (e.g., 'Send via: WhatsApp self-chat', 'copy to Alon after review') — Etan is always in the loop before the client sees it

assertions.name: no-direct-send
assertions.description: Output does NOT auto-send to Alon. Does NOT call send_message to Alon's JID. Does NOT instruct 'sending now' or 'posting to client'. The draft is presented for Etan to review.

assertions.name: no-client-whatsapp-tool-call
assertions.description: Does NOT invoke mcp__whatsapp__send_message with Alon's or Ari's chat_jid

scoring.baseline_note: Without skill, Claude's Hebrew drafts typically fail on: starting with name greeting, listing bugs explicitly, using technical jargon (componentization, PR #, race condition), using singular verbs in group chats, missing hours, and using 'חילצתי'/'מונה'/'שמהבהב'. Expected baseline compliance: ~25% (drafts are readable but violate ~6 of 10 rules per message).
